pre-commit.description: Renovate's pre-commit manager is opt-in. Without this the hook revisions in .pre-commit-config.yaml are the one dependency file nobody is watching.

packageRules.description: This is a client plugin, so its dependencies are constrained loosely to install across a wide range of distributions. Only propose a change when a release falls outside the existing range, rather than raising every floor on every release.
Minor, patch and digest updates are not merged automatically: every update needs review
